svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Official Straight Thin Wide logo, font and color studies
svg.desc: Six numbered studies preserve the official crest geometry. Original Official is an exact copy. Track Precision uses DIN Alternate with original colors. Geometric GT uses Futura with original colors. Graphite and Ember uses Helvetica Neue. Forest and Gold uses Optima. Burgundy and Ivory uses Georgia. Each shows a logo with text, standalone crest, font name and palette.

g.text: Designs / V1 / Typeface and color explorations
Straight Thin Wide is the official logo. Every study retains its exact crest, car and straight thin bubbles.
Exact official artwork / original colors and font

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer — Straight Thin Wide
svg.desc: The original navy Grand Tourer shield, red crown and white front-facing car are retained unchanged. Three filled racing-red thought bubbles retain the thin heights, widths, rounded ends and vertical positions of Thin Wide Weave, with all three centers aligned straight beneath the car.

g.text: Font study / original navy, red and white

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Track Precision
svg.desc: The official Driver Dreamer navy shield, red crown, original white front-facing car and three centered thin red thought bubbles retain their exact geometry and original colors. The Track Precision wordmark uses DIN Alternate at size 66 and weight 700 with letter spacing minus 1, preserving the original text, placement and two-color treatment.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Graphite & Ember
svg.desc: Driver Dreamer's official Straight Thin Wide crest retains its exact shield, car, crown and centered thin thought-bubble geometry. This design explores the Graphite and Ember palette: #191C22, #E86A33 and #FFFFFF. The Driver Dreamer wordmark uses Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif.
